title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode7 What This Stage Means To Us

meta.Episode: Episode7 — What This Stage Means To Us
meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Line: Stage

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope you'll listen!
se_event_then_2022_012

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I, umm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: M-Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Tongue-tied right out of the gates. That sure is a unique talent.

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been looking up to a certain idol ever since I was little... I've always wanted to be an idol just like her...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But things really didn't go all that well... I failed pretty much every audition I applied for...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, being able to stand here today...
I still can't believe this is really happening right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Uhh...
Everyone who's been following MORE MORE JUMP! since we first formed might already know this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I had so much trouble doing anything in the beginning. I felt awful because I thought that I was holding the others back...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
N-No, that's not true!
We know you were doing your best, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: However, as concerned as I was, I didn't want to give up on my dream. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I really love MORE MORE JUMP!
That's why I decided to do everything I could to make sure we could spread hope to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I...
I had a realization as we kept doing stuff together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Idols don't just give hope to others!
We're also in a position to receive hope!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Receive hope...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! has given me so much! They taught me everything about being an idol... From how to carry myself emotionally to all the techniques I need to know...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, and Airi taught me so much leading up to today's performance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And everyone in SEKAI... No, wait!
I meant all the other idols who've helped me along the way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They helped me as I practiced my dancing, gave me advice when I had something on my mind... And I can't thank them enough for it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, is she talking about us...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, that's so sweet of her...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I need to thank our invited guests for their contributions as well. We're standing here today because you were there for us when we really needed your help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All of these people around us have given our group so much... More than I can recall... We appreciate each and every one of you for what you've done.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But above all else...
The ones I need to thank the most are...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All of you! The fans!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're a little different from the idols you're all probably used to seeing... But we've been able to put on events and other fun activities because of your help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also! These adorable outfits that Shizuku designed! We wouldn't be wearing them right now if it weren't for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: They look amazing!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
We love them!!
They're so cute!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Again, we can't even begin to show our appreciation...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I'm able to stand here today because... Even though I still have a long way to go as an idol, you've been willing to support me.

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know that I still need a lot of work, so it feels a little strange hearing you all cheer for me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But each of your calls and cheers means so much to me... They really mean everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're like raindrops that fall on my head and fill my heart with joy. Each one makes me want to try just that much harder!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, once more...
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Thank you too!!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm so glad that I kept rooting for you, Minori!! I promise to be your fan forever!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you! I'll be looking forward to your continued support!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I don't know what to say...
All your kind words have left me speechless.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And, um... I know I've been talking for a while now... But the person you see standing here today...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She wants to take everything you've given her and make this show as amazing as possible...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, uh... How's the show been?!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Amazing!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It's been really amazing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great to hear!
Over the course of this show, I've been feeling so much of your energy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is what I've always wanted to do... It's been my dream to perform on stage and bring our hearts together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Each and every one of you helped make that happen. So, to everyone in attendance...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To Airi and Shizuku, who helped prepare me to perform on this stage...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And to my hero...
My role model forever... Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I appreciate everything you've all done for me! Thank you all so so so much!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for giving us such a wonderful speech, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It was?
I'm not sure if what I said just now made any sense.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
Just take a look at everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: That was awesome!!!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: We love MMJ!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The rest of us are well aware that Minori didn't have it easy at first since we all have experience being idols...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But you kept persevering, Minori.
As a result, you gave us an enormous amount of hope and encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's the reason why I'm so happy to be standing on this stage with you today. Because I know this solo show is your big moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, let's keep doing our best...
Together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Haruka!
I finally made it this far.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin! Here's a bouquet of hope for you! Hello!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to do my absolute best moving forward, and I hope you'll be there to support me!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I'm so moved by just how much Minori's grown as an idol. I think I'm gonna cry...

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's pretty great...
It must've been so hard until now since the other members of MMJ are famous idols.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
But Minori's different...
She understands why idols are so great. It's like she's growing with us... It's hard not to root for her...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
(That's exactly right...
Minori works super hard at everything. She gives you so much energy that there's no way you can't cheer for her.)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (I'm so glad everyone else understands that too. But...)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: (I want more and more people to see just how amazing Minori really is...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's time for our last song!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Get ready, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is our surprise to you!
Let's keep raising the energy in this place!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: More and more and more!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: (My song... It's become the last song of this incredible show...)

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: (So much happened while writing it too... I caused them so much trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, you two okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<*Sob*
Our feelings started to synchronize after watching them all this time...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
This show... It's way too good...!!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. I know exactly how you feel...
They've become such wonderful idols.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, and they've certainly given me quite a bit of hope.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Also, I think Minori was spot on about how idols are able to both give and receive hope.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I agree.
Idols have a close relationship with their audience...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So it's only natural for both parties to cheer for one another. It's really a wonderful thing.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I wanna see them grow even more as idols... I wanna see them really make it big...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Me too...
And I'm sure they'll be able to spread hope to so many people down the road.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thank you all so much for inviting us to see this incredible show...!>
